login.lede: This is your own deployment. Authenticate as the owner.
login.recoverLink: Locked out? Recover with a phrase →

recover.lede: Enter your email and the recovery phrase we emailed you. It signs you back in once — then set a new password.

confirmEmail.confirmedBody: You sign in with {email} from now on, and that is where your recovery phrase goes.
confirmEmail.expiredBody: Confirmation links last 24 hours. Nothing changed — your sign-in is still on the old address. Open your account page and save the new email again to get a fresh link.
confirmEmail.invalidBody: It may already have been used, or it may have been replaced by a newer request. Nothing changed — your sign-in is still on the address you had.

reset.missingHelp: Run make password-reset on the host to get a fresh one-time link.
reset.lede: Token good for 30 minutes after the host CLI issued it.

setup.lede: Nobody has claimed this deployment yet. The first person to sign up becomes the owner. Everything lives in your own database.
setup.providerIntro: Used to power your visitor chat. The key stays in your instance only; visitors with BYOAI bring their own.
setup.providerSkip: you can skip this for now and configure later under admin → account.
setup.verifyIntro: Check this over — it is what the instance will be named and how you will sign in. The setup token in your server log is what proves this deployment is yours.

setupPage.missingHelp: The setup URL is printed in the backend log when the instance starts. Look for a line containing setup?t=….
